lines.en: I tread the molten hills' black stone.
My horn catches the low branches first.
Four hooves on warm ground.
I follow my owner slowly.
I shake the mane at my neck.
I avoid the still-glowing cracks.
My prints are deep and round.
I walk along the hill's base.
I lower my head against the hot wind.
My steps are steady.
I stop and wait.
I walk at your side, a little behind.
Ash clings to my horn.
I turn over a loose stone.
My breath steams white.

lines.zh: 我沿着热气升的方向走。
lines.en: I walk toward the rising heat.
I stand and swish my tail.
I lower my head and rub a foreleg.
My horn gleams in the heat.
I listen to sounds below the hill.

lines.zh: 我把身子贴着一块暖石。
lines.en: I lean against a warm stone.
I slowly chew a root.
I wait for the whistle that calls my name.
Heat lifts my mane.
My ears swivel toward the lava's sound.
A snort puffs out a little hot ash.
I count the stones underfoot.
I stand quite at ease.
Have you come to lead me?
That feeding hand — I know it.
You smell of hay.
Don't stand in front of my horns.
You may touch my neck.
I've walked these hills many times.
Would you like to ride?
Behind you. Walk slower.

lines.zh: 你的手凉，像没烤过的石。
lines.en: Your hands are cold, like unheated stone.
I lower my head for you to touch the horn.
Don't pull too sharply.
We're heading the same way.
My horn took a knock.
I step off to the side.
A cut on my hide.
I snort sharply.
This doesn't stop me walking.
I raise my head to see who.

lines.zh: 熔岩山丘的角，也是热的。
lines.en: Even my horn is warm on the molten hills.
I back toward the stones.
I didn't deserve that.
Stop hitting.
Is this tender grass?
Offer it, let me sniff.
This grass smells like my feed trough.
My horns have butted stone.
I stretch my neck for it.
Tender grass is scarce on these hills.
I chew slowly, no rush.
You're kind.
Another handful.
I come a little nearer.
Better than the moss on stone.
Do not pull your hand back; let me sniff.
You nudged me with your shoulder.
I step back, horn still low.
Don't crowd my flank.
I'm large, but I don't charge.
You stepped on my hoof.
My horn tip grazes your shoulder.
I shift aside a little.
That little bump doesn't bother me.
You shook ash onto my back.
Crowd me and I'll turn away.
I follow my owner.
I don't understand such things.
My horns could hurt someone.
Feed me first.
These hills are too hot for that.
I answer to one owner only.
Wait until the wind cools.
I'm off to find a puddle.
Don't pull my mane.
Let's change the subject.
Good moss on the ground.
I lower my head and take it.
This is edible.
Too hot, I spit it out.
I drag it into the shade.
You needn't feed me that.
This mineral smell is very strange.
I sniff a long while before biting.
Save it for later.
Could you pick that up for me?
Those stones are moving.
I lower my head, horns forward.
Someone is near my owner.
I turn broadside and block the way.
My hoof scrapes the ground.
This close, my horns move first.

lines.zh: 你手里那把草，晃得我心痒。
lines.en: That grass in your hand makes me twitch.
You've taken the wrong path.
Take three steps back and I let it pass.
Step back.
I'm going to charge.
Don't blame my horns.
I guard this ground.
You hear me snort.
I turn sideways, horn toward you.
You cannot bear the weight of me.
This will break bone.
My hind hooves paw the volcanic ash.
You're in front of my horn.
I score two lines in the ground.
Retreating won't be fast enough.
A few yards of run-up is all.
My shadow is coming over you.
What you raise won't stop me.
I'm counting.
Two counts left.
This moment.
I lower my horns and break into a trot.
My horn tip catches your armor.
My forehooves kick the shield.
One toss of my horns sends you back.
I stop right after the charge.
That numbed me too.
Your weapon flew off.
I snort and lower my head again.
Your armor dented.
After the butt, I flick my tail and leave.
My forehooves can kick stone apart.

lines.zh: 我从丘后的石堆里出来。
lines.en: I come out from behind the rocks.
Another horn on the molten hills.
I shake the ash off my back.
I raise my head, horn catching light.
I test the ground with a hoof.

lines.zh: 我慢慢走到有草的地方。
lines.en: I walk over to where the grass is.
I blow out a plume of steam.
It's hot, but I'm used to it.

lines.zh: 我在找一处能歇脚的石。
lines.en: I look for stone to rest by.
Someone called me.

lines.zh: 火烤到我身上，我猛一跳。
lines.en: Fire hits me and I bolt.

lines.zh: 我从坡上滑下，摔了膝盖。
lines.en: I slide down the slope and land on a knee.

lines.zh: 熔岩丘陵的角，我只有一对。
lines.en: I've only one pair of horns from the molten hills.
The blast lifts me off my hooves.

lines.zh: 这东西扎在我的厚皮上。
lines.en: That buried in my thick hide.

lines.zh: 咒力让我四条腿都僵了。
lines.en: Magic stiffens all four legs.
So hungry my legs give way.
Lightning strikes and all four hooves leave ground.

lines.zh: 虚空里没有可以踏的石头。
lines.en: No stone to stand on in the void.
